title: research.jsonc
description: What one research costs and how long it takes, at frontier price (game design 1.3). The multipliers for other price bands are in rules.jsonc.

tiers.description: One entry for each tier from 2 to the last tier, in order.

cost.description: Paid when the research starts, before the price band's multiplier.

seconds.description: Research time in seconds. It must be a whole number of ticks.

number.description: A whole number, or text in plain decimal notation such as "2.6". A bare number with a fraction is not accepted, so that every value is read exactly.
